name: makefile-recipe-entry
description: The recipe lines of the target root's makefile are read as command strings, each line up to its shell comment, and a cd command moves the directory the later commands of its line are read against, so a file a recipe runs or names is rooted. Each line of the makefile that is no recipe line is read too, up to its comment, so a file only a variable names is held, nothing it exports is reported, and the package has one note, while a file only a comment names, of a recipe line or of a variable's line, is reported.
